pairs.subject: transactions-over-a-replicated-log
pairs.evidence: crates/core/src/storage.rs:587 The job queue writes straight to a single-node SQLite WAL pool, with no consensus log or replicated state machine underneath. Searches for consensus, replicated_log, applied_index, log_index and quorum found nothing in crates/core or in any *.rs/*.toml file in the repo, so the subject's precondition does not hold.

techniques.evidence: crates/core/src/storage.rs:545 Writes go to local SQLite with no consensus round trip, so there is no commit entry and no apply step to verify at.
crates/core/src/storage.rs:587 No log library is asking for snapshots. The WAL here is SQLite's own journal, not a replicated log.
crates/core/src/storage.rs:567 There is no log index. trigger_generation is a related in-process ordering rule (read the label before the SELECT), not an index into a replicated log.
